body:
@shakefu, going further we would like to propose you to have:

```jsx
<SearchBox
  resetComponent={() => 'reset'}
  submitComponent={() => 'Submit'}
/>
```

Since we switched to an icon based default searchbox, providing translations for reset and submit is no more relevant, we are not translating anything here, just hacking around.

That's why we think letting you provide your own reset and submit components is maybe the best idea, so you could even configure icons.

Another solution for you would be to switch to [connectSearchBox](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/connectors/connectSearchBox.html) since you are willing to change the complete design of it now.

What do you think?
